Third round on the design index and Markdown integration (commit pending push).

Tree and breadcrumb follow the document: opening a document now also shows where it is linked. A new effect in DesignBrowser resolves the document's ordered associations to a C4 element (element link, or the source element of a relationship, or the owner of a linked UML artifact or mockup), preferring whichever target is already shown, and selects it. The header breadcrumb therefore reads the document's real path (System Context > ... > the linked element) and the tree highlights and opens exactly that branch, including after association edits (documentLinkVersion).

One clean side panel: the document session moved out of the editor into useDocumentSession (DocumentEditor.tsx), shared by both columns, so the document area and the side panel can no longer disagree about the document. The content column now holds only the panel heading, the title, the Markdown body and the save/discard/delete actions plus status, conflict and save-error reporting. The side panel holds everything about the document's links: the ordered Associations list (each entry opens its design entity, with move-earlier and Detach) and the Choose design/Associate controls, followed by Referenced by. The duplicate "Related designs" section is gone. The draft stays in the session module map, so switching documents cannot leak another document's draft, prompt or status.

Acceptance: npx tsc --noEmit clean; QA job 249560800 run 9887711878 (build, npm run build) passed on 2026-09-29; the native editor script now drives the association combobox, Associate and Detach inside the document inspector and still passes node --check. Not verified here: Playwright/WebView2 cannot run on this Linux host and the GUI was not visually inspected.

Rework the Adashi desktop design workspace so Markdown design documents are first-class design artefacts inside the design panel instead of a separate replacing panel, and rework the design tree navigation.

Scope
1. Design tree navigation (src/main.tsx DesignBrowser index panel):
   - Rename the "System Context" level tab to "Tree View". It shows the whole C4 tree, always expanded, with the element currently shown in the viewer selected/scrolled into view.
   - After the tree, list all artefacts (UML diagrams and Markdown documents) that are not attached/linked anywhere in the tree, each clickable.
   - Below the "Tree View" button add buttons: Components, UML Artifacts, Documents. Selecting one shows a flat list of all artefacts of that kind instead of the tree.
2. Markdown documents open inside the design panel (main column) while the design index and inspector stay visible; they no longer replace the whole workspace. Documents mode of the index lists the documents with New/Import/find.
3. Markdown documents link to any C4 element (Software System, Container, Component) and appear as clickable links in that element's view (viewer header links already exist; add the linked-document list to the element inspector).
4. Markdown editor fixes: open in Preview by default, and make long content scrollable instead of being clipped.

Acceptance
- `npm run build` (tsc + vite) succeeds with no type errors.
- Manual: selecting a document keeps the design index + inspector; the tree shows Tree View, Components, UML Artifacts, Documents modes; the editor starts in Preview; long documents scroll.

data.title: Integrate Markdown documents into the design panel and rework design tree navigation
